name: Build the candidate-facing documents: the posting, the transparency sheet, and the interim web drawing
text_content:
Type: instrument

Per specifications I3, I5, and I6. The posting is derived from the seat sheet, states only what the sheet states, and passes every sentence through canon's five voice rules and six binary tests in sequence with test five, the competitor test, run on every sentence and the pass recorded; the forbidden lexicon removes the industry's job-posting vocabulary outright, and "welcome," "enjoy," exclamation points, emoji, "we believe," "we are committed to," the founders' story, urgency signals, and social proof do not appear. The transparency sheet is the record's own artifact, held whole and extended to nine items: the web, the domain lead, the compensation commitments in the record's words with no figure and no percentage, communication expectations, the training plan with pay dates, the mechanics (Session 13's, and W4 rules whether an interview runs before they land), the advancement path, the seat's decision-rights range, and the three non-negotiables. It is handed at the first interview in the candidate's interview language, identical for every candidate for the same seat, and is the version the offer is made on. Item 1 carries the candidate's neighborhood drawn by hand until W17's designed render exists. The careers surface is the Greenhouse-hosted board until the website IA closes; the designed careers page is gated on that IA. Gated on the document methodology, W19, and W8 for the register.

Filed by Session 5 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmhm4. Reasoning lives on the S5 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.

comment.text: Session 13 gives item 6 its source and its two states: the compensation mechanics page (work item A12) is the single source item 6 reads from, and item 6 reads either as the whole mechanism with values set, or as the whole mechanism with values marked unset under the founders' ruling on a first interview, and never as a figure this program generated. Item 3's benefits line states which benefits exist at hire as facts and the path to full benefits as a gate with no date (work item A9). S13 page, sections 9.9 and 13.5; P25, P39, P40; readiness rows 161 and 168.
